userStories.title: Skill Preview Modal with Full Description
userStories.description: In the Skills Marketplace (SpecsPanel Marketplace tab), clicking any skill card — whether it's a discovered skill from the GitHub repo browser, a skills.sh search result, or an installed skill in the library — should open a preview modal showing the full SKILL.md content. The modal should reuse the existing `GET /api/skills/preview` endpoint for uninstalled skills (passing the skill name/source as query params) and `GET /api/skills/:name/content` for installed skills. The modal should render the markdown content with syntax highlighting, show skill metadata (name, description, category, source), and include an Install button for uninstalled skills or an Uninstall button for installed ones. Close via Escape key or clicking outside the modal.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking any skill card in the Discovered, skills.sh, or Installed tabs opens a modal overlay rendering the full SKILL.md markdown content fetched from the appropriate API endpoint
The modal displays skill metadata: name, category tag, source repo URL, and install status badge
Uninstalled skills show an Install button that triggers installation and updates the button state to Uninstall on success
Installed skills show an Uninstall button that triggers deletion and closes the modal on success
The modal closes when pressing Escape or clicking the backdrop overlay
